<!--
THE PRESS RELEASE GAP REPORT

A "Press Release Gap" (PRG) occurs when a law school has publicly marketed a
program, center, course, or initiative that no longer exists or no longer functions
as described — and the school continues to benefit reputationally from the original
announcement without disclosing the change.

This is the Tech-Friendly Law School Ranking's most important accountability
mechanism. We take PRG reports seriously and investigate all credible reports.

WHAT QUALIFIES:
✓ A program was announced via press release, website, or admissions materials
✓ Evidence shows the program no longer exists or operates substantially differently
✓ The school has not publicly disclosed the change
✓ There is a meaningful time gap (the announcement is not from last month)

WHAT DOES NOT QUALIFY:
✗ Normal program evolution or routine updates
✗ Programs that are still active but you personally dislike
✗ Claims without source evidence
✗ Rumors or secondhand reports without verifiable sources

Submitting a false or malicious PRG report may result in your report being
dismissed and your GitHub account being blocked from further submissions.
-->
